notes.title: v1.15 HOTFIX
notes.content:
Thanks to some feedback, I was able to catch a major oversight that had one of the very first mushrooms valued at 25k instead of 25...I apologize if this effected your gameplay experience.

I have addressed this and updated font to be something more readable.

I am going through all of the mushroom values to ensure they're correct, I believe this was the only one and was due to a full adjustment of the mushroom values with the last update.

Please let me know of any other issues.

Thank you so much for your support, happy growing!
